Drop the Rc and move `tile` into the closure directly: `Widget::stateful_builder(tile.controller.revision.cell(), move |context| { ... })`. stateful_builder already stores the Fn closure behind its own Rc, and the closure only reads `tile` through `&self`, so the extra Rc<ExpansionTile> allocation per build is redundant. Read `tile.controller.revision.cell()` before the move, as it is today.

Drop both Rc wrappers: `let first_height = std::cell::Cell::new(None::<f32>);` and move `bar` and `first_height` straight into the `LayoutBuilder::new(move |context, constraints| ...)` closure. LayoutBuilder::new already wraps the Fn closure in its own Rc, and nothing else holds `first_height`, so the Cell can be owned by the closure directly.

Drop the Rc and move `selector` into the closure: `Widget::stateful_builder(selector.controller.revision_cell(), move |context| { ... })`. The closure only reads `selector` through `&self`, and stateful_builder already holds the Fn closure behind its own Rc, so the extra Rc<TabPageSelector> allocation is redundant.
